column1: # Does /v1/models report the real state of dynamically loaded adapters?
# Route: dynlora-route, static, indexes model-dyn + adapter-1..4 and never changes.
# Runtime: nothing preloaded; every adapter arrives via an admin call.
# gateway http://172.18.255.2  ns dynamic-lora  pod svc-dyn-kserve-579c658759-xmpnh
# --- phase 1: list vs admin calls (adapterctl loads BOTH names) ---
# --- phase 2: listed? vs serves? for every indexed adapter ---
# direct = on the pod, no gateway. gateway = shared endpoint via the header index.
# --- phase 3: unloading ONE name of a dual-registered adapter ---
# vLLM keys its adapter table by name, so two names for one set of weights
# are two independent entries. Unload takes a single lora_name.
